unit: experiments2/V16 monthly Top1 same-lookback positive momentum gate

rule.signal: first observed trading session of each calendar month at close
rule.ranking: descending cross-sectional total return; equal-weight fixed Top1
rule.positive_momentum_gate: hold selected Top1 only when its own same-lookback return is strictly >0; else empty target/cash
rule.same_ledger_ungated_comparator: V15 monthly Top1 for each lookback
rule.final_liquidation: last day of each ledger window, forced at open by audited account engine

audit.ledger_rule: copied V15/V4 audited cash ledger; lots, amount capacity, limit locks, fees and slippage enabled
